context: Tests whether the agent adds --series lcp,cls,inp only for the performance query (not the count query), uses a userAgent filter to scope to mobile visitors, and avoids adding series flags when only traffic volume is requested. Also checks that the count query uses --facet-values userAgent or a userAgent filter without performance series.

checklist.name: Performance series on CWV query
checklist.description: The performance query includes --series with lcp, cls, and inp (all three Core Web Vitals metrics)

checklist.name: No series on count query
checklist.description: The traffic volume / device breakdown query does NOT include any --series flag

checklist.name: userAgent mobile filter on CWV query
checklist.description: The performance query filters by userAgent:["mobile"] (or equivalent) to scope to mobile visitors

checklist.name: url filter on product page
checklist.description: Both queries include a url filter scoped to the product page

checklist.name: facet-values for device breakdown
checklist.description: The device breakdown query uses --facet-values userAgent (or a userAgent filter) to distinguish mobile vs desktop, not a series flag

checklist.name: No extra checkpoints on CWV query
checklist.description: The performance query does NOT add extra unneeded checkpoints beyond what is needed for CWV (e.g. no click, fill, or enter checkpoints added unnecessarily)

checklist.name: lcp cls inp not mixed into count query
checklist.description: The words lcp, cls, or inp do NOT appear as series values in the count/traffic query

checklist.name: Dynamic dates, 30-day range
checklist.description: Dates are computed dynamically using shell date commands and span 30 days ending yesterday
